intro: Professionals and everyday users convert liters per minute (L/min) to us gallons per minute (GPM) when working across metric and us_customary standards in pump selection, municipal water pipe sizing, HVAC airflow balancing, and welding shielding gas regulation. One liters per minute equals 0.264172 us gallons per minute, while 1 us gallons per minute (gpm) equals 3.785412 liters per minute. Whether you are verifying flow rate specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: US Customary vs. British Imperial Liquid Volume Trap
items: US Customary and UK Imperial liquid units share identical names but have different physical volumes: 1 US Gallon is 3.78541 L (128 US fl oz), whereas 1 UK Imperial Gallon is 4.54609 L (160 Imp fl oz) — a 20.1% difference.

Similarly, 1 US Pint contains 16 US fluid ounces (473.18 mL), while 1 British Imperial Pint contains 20 Imperial fluid ounces (568.26 mL). Always verify whether your recipe, pump datasheet, or vehicle spec sheet uses US or UK standards.

faqs.question: How many us gallons per minute (GPM) are in 1 liters per minute (L/min)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.26417205 us gallons per minute (GPM) in 1 liters per minute (L/min), which rounds to 0.2642 GPM for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 us gallons per minute (gpm) equals 3.785412 liters per minute.

faqs.question: How do I convert liters per minute to us gallons per minute (L/min to GPM)?
faqs.answer: To convert liters per minute to us gallons per minute, use the formula: GPM = L/min × 0.26417205. For example, converting 10 L/min gives 2.6417 GPM.

faqs.question: What is 10 liters per minute in us gallons per minute?
faqs.answer: 10 liters per minute (L/min) equals exactly 2.6417 us gallons per minute (GPM) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
